helpCenter.content:
What do I need to know?

This allowance is mandatory for employees who use their personal equipment for work. It is typically calculated based on the anticipated depreciation of the equipment.

For example, if an employee’s personal laptop is valued at USD 3,000 and its usual lifespan would be 1,000 working days, then the employee using their personal laptop must be reimbursed USD 3 per working day.
